dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Ivar
dialogues.text: I've been doing pretty well, thanks. How about you? How's the workload been? Is Rollon giving you any trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's all part of the job, and I manage it just fine. Rollon, though...? He'd never cause trouble. If anything, he's the one looking out for me.

dialogues.speaker: Ivar
dialogues.text: Good, good. I suppose that's part of his job, too. I know you all work hard, but please, don't ignore any minor injuries or sicknesses. Make sure to take care of them right away.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, got it. You take care of yourself too, Ivar.
